name: Rozetka Marketplace
description: Rozetka Marketplace seller API for Ukraine's largest marketplace: search and read orders with items, delivery and buyer, order statuses, and the seller's goods. Signs in with the seller cabinet login. Read-only.
instructions:
Rozetka is Ukraine's largest online marketplace. This adapter reads a seller's orders, order statuses and goods through the Rozetka Marketplace seller API (`https://api-seller.rozetka.com.ua`).

**Getting credentials**
The API signs in with the login and password of the Rozetka seller cabinet (seller.rozetka.com.ua); there is no separate API key.
1. Put the cabinet login in `ROZETKA_USERNAME`.
2. Rozetka expects the password Base64-encoded, so `ROZETKA_PASSWORD_BASE64` takes the encoded form, not the plain password. Encode it on your own computer, e.g. in a terminal `printf '%s' 'your-password' | base64`, and paste the result. Do not use an online encoder for a real password.
AnythingMCP logs in with `POST /sites` and sends the session token as a Bearer token. Rozetka keeps a token alive while it is used and lets it expire after 24 hours without use; the adapter signs in again every four hours. A wrong login or password is reported as `incorrect_username_password`.

**Workflow**
1. `rozetka_list_order_statuses` maps the numeric `status` of an order to its name (`name_ua`, `name_en`).
2. `rozetka_list_orders` with `types` (2 in processing, 4 new, 5 being delivered, 3 completed, 6 failed, 1 all) or date filters, then `rozetka_get_order` for one order. Add `expand=purchases,delivery,user` to see the items, the delivery and the buyer.
3. `rozetka_list_goods` searches the seller's goods by name, article or id; `rozetka_get_goods` returns one item by `item_id` or `rz_item_id`.

**Formats and gotchas**
- Rozetka answers HTTP 200 even when a call fails: read `success`. When it is false, `errors.message` and `errors.code` say why, e.g. `incorrect_access_token` (1020).
- Prices of goods are in UAH. Dates in filters are YYYY-MM-DD.
- Texts come in the cabinet's language (Ukrainian or Russian).

**Pagination and limits**: results sit under `content` with `_meta` (`totalCount`, `pageCount`, `currentPage`, `perPage`). Call again with `page` + 1 until `currentPage` equals `pageCount`. Orders come 20 per page; goods accept `pageSize`. No rate limit is published; avoid tight loops.

**Cloud reachability**: api-seller.rozetka.com.ua is public over HTTPS, reachable from AnythingMCP Cloud and from self-hosted installs. This adapter is read-only.

ROZETKA_USERNAME.label: Seller cabinet login
ROZETKA_USERNAME.help: The login you use for the Rozetka seller cabinet at seller.rozetka.com.ua.

ROZETKA_PASSWORD_BASE64.label: Password (Base64-encoded)
ROZETKA_PASSWORD_BASE64.help: Rozetka expects the cabinet password Base64-encoded. Encode it locally, e.g. printf '%s' 'your-password' | base64, and paste the result.
ROZETKA_PASSWORD_BASE64.patternMessage: Paste the Base64-encoded password (letters, digits, + and /, optionally ending in =), not the plain password.

tools.name: rozetka_list_orders
tools.description: Search the seller's Rozetka orders, 20 per page, by status group, status, creation or change date, order id, buyer phone or waybill (TTN). Use expand to include purchased items, delivery and buyer.

types.description: Status group: 1 all, 2 in processing, 3 completed, 4 new, 5 being delivered, 6 failed.

created_from.description: Created on or after. Date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-01.

created_to.description: Created on or before. Date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-01.

changed_from.description: Changed on or after. Date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-01.

changed_to.description: Changed on or before. Date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-01.

ttn.description: Waybill number, at least 4 characters; 1 = orders with a waybill, 0 = orders without.

sort.description: Sort column, prefix - for descending: id, created, changed, amount, status. E.g. -created.

tools.name: rozetka_get_order
tools.description: Get one Rozetka order by id with amounts, status and comments. Use expand for items (purchases), delivery, buyer (user), status history (order_status_history) or payment details.

tools.name: rozetka_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List Rozetka order statuses with id, Ukrainian, Russian and English name and status group, to read the numeric status of an order.

status_group.description: Status group id (1, 2 or 3), the same value as status_group on an order.

tools.name: rozetka_list_goods
tools.description: Search the seller's goods on Rozetka (all tabs) by name, text, article, price-list id or Rozetka id, availability or category. Returns ids, names, prices, stock state and Rozetka links.

price_offer_id.description: Id of the goods in the seller's price list.

rz_item_id.description: Id of the goods on Rozetka.

available.description: 0 out of stock, 1 in stock, 2 removed from the price list.

sort.description: Sort: price_offer_id, rz_item_id, price, price_old or price_promo, prefix - for descending.

tools.name: rozetka_get_goods
tools.description: Get the details of one of the seller's goods on Rozetka (prices, category, description, stock state) by the internal item_id or by rz_item_id. Pass one of the two.

item_id.description: Internal id of the goods (item_id in rozetka_list_goods).

rz_item_id.description: Id of the goods on Rozetka.
